name: Weekly Inverse-Volatility Portfolio (SPY/TLT/GLD/DBC)
description: Weekly rebalanced inverse-volatility portfolio across SPY, TLT, GLD, and DBC. Computes 21-day annualized realized volatility for each asset, weights inversely proportional to vol, caps individual weights at 40% (renormalized), and rebalances on the first trading day of each week. Long-only, always fully invested, no leverage. Auto-generated tearsheet provides equity curve, drawdown, Sharpe, Sortino, Calmar, and monthly returns heatmap.
source:
# ============================================================================
# Weekly Inverse-Volatility Portfolio: SPY / TLT / GLD / DBC
# ----------------------------------------------------------------------------
# Rebalances weekly (first trading day of week). Weights = 1/vol, capped at 40%.
# Long-only, always fully invested, no stops, no leverage.
# ============================================================================

# --- Data ---
src = study_assets()

# --- Volatility (21-day annualized, decimal fraction) ---
# volatility() takes close prices and internally computes returns then annualizes (S47)
vol_21 = volatility(src.c, method=VolMethod.annualized, period=21)

# --- Rebalance Trigger: first trading day of each week ---
ts = index().value
is_rebal = is_period_boundary(period=PeriodType.week, boundary=BoundaryType.start)(ts)

# --- Inverse-Volatility Weights (cross-sectional, capped at 40%) ---
# inv_vol_weight takes (active_mask: Boolean, volatility: Decimal)
# max_weight=0.4 caps each asset at 40% and renormalizes
# All assets always active (long-only, fully invested)
always_active = is_valid(vol_21)
weights = inv_vol_weight(max_weight=0.4)(active_mask=always_active, volatility=vol_21)

# Fallback: if vol unavailable, equal weight (25% each for 4 assets)
# inv_vol_weight returns 0 when active_mask=False; coalesce to equal weight
raw_weight = weights.weight * 100
final_weight = coalesce(raw_weight, 25.0)

# --- Execution ---
# Long-only: persistent True entry, no short side
long_and_short_zone()(long_entry=always_active)

# Position sizing: percent of equity, rebalance only on weekly boundary
position_size(type=SizeType.percent)(size=final_weight, rebalance_on=is_rebal)
